dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, jagged light-toned O-shaped perimeters. The most prominent 4 structures show a high-contrast transition from a dark exterior to a light-tan serrated boundary surrounding a dark interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of small, high-intensity punctate pixel clusters concentrated in the ventral-anterior neck region and within the dark centers of mid-body annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent mid-lateral annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle pattern.
